source_excerpt: Breeding system studies in the selected taxa revealed that they were all self and cross-compatible species. source_excerpt: No fruits matured in Treatment 1 (autonomous selfing), but all flowers in Treatment 2 (hand-selfing) and Treatment 3 (hand-crossing) matured into fruits.
